scientific_integrity: The exact symmetric mean prefactor and published finite-rate mean/transform theory are explicitly credited. Numerical checks are corroborative, not substitutes for the analytic argument. No external review or independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The limiting theorem holds for fixed real detuning as Poisson reset rate increases; diffusion is reflected on a finite interval and retains endpoint-visit flags. It neither proves finite-rate independent endpoint hits nor joint path convergence, and does not treat non-Poisson reset clocks, finite detection radii, or noninstantaneous resets. Publication priority is subject to independent literature validation.
title: A moving-symmetry two-clock law for rapid-reset Brownian interval coverage
